reports.dimension_interpretation: For K7_C0005, this set-scope analysis tests whether the target candidate's membership relative to the rest of the partition is associated with measured technical, acquisition, or site factors. tissue_source_site shows corrected-significant categorical association, and ct_z_spacing shows corrected-significant continuous association, so measured site/acquisition factors remain plausible candidate-specific alternative explanations for this set. These are univariable associations, not causal contributions, and they do not establish that the structure is artifactual.
reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior confounder_exclusion Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so this set-scope association analysis stands as the initial confounder evidence for K7_C0005 and cannot yet be cross-checked against the partition-scope confounder analyses. It is complementary to the structural and biological reports in that it addresses whether measured technical/acquisition factors remain plausible candidate-specific alternative explanations, a different question from whether boundaries are expressed in native geometry or carry coherent molecular programs.
limitations: Association is not causation; a significant association is not proof of technical artifact.
The analysis reports univariable association of factors with membership; it does not perform covariate adjustment or establish persistence of structure after adjustment.
Several categorical factors are imbalanced with sparse or singleton levels, which limits estimate stability.
Categorical and continuous factors are tested in separate families, and p/q values across families are not directly comparable.
